messages:
noah: Quick internal broadcast: Hosted streaming runtime (server-side tool routing + adaptive chunking) is now GA in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Rolling started at 08:00 UTC. Docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/stream-ga :tada:

tanya: Nice! Any immediate client changes required?

noah: Minimal. Clients should switch to the /v3/stream endpoint and add header X-Stream-Mode: adaptive for best billing. Back-compat layer for /v2/stream will be live for 14 days.

eng-runtime: Note for SDK teams: new StreamingSession object handles reconnects and tool-call acknowledgements. Also adds a streaming backpressure signal. We'll land SDK PRs this afternoon.

ops-amy: Rollout plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% across both regions, watching p95 latency and tool error rate. Pager thresholds: p95 > baseline + 200ms OR tool invocation errors > 2%. I'll post alerts to #incidents if anything pops. :rotating_light:

noah: Billing/finance heads up: adaptive chunking may reduce billed tokens for avg 1-3 turn chats. Finance will get a short report after 24h.

deploy-bot: deploy/stream-runtime-ga initiated by @noah 8:00 UTC 77-03-26 canary 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> full.
